question: Should Discord's unset component callback TTL default change from 30 minutes to 7 days, and should explicit overrides allow up to 30 days?
rationale: This changes how long existing visible Discord controls can trigger authorized callback work after upgrade, so code review cannot safely choose the stale-action/security tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Accept 7 days and 30 days after docs fix
options.body: Land the proposed policy once the stale gateway config reference is updated and maintainers accept the longer authorized callback window.

options.title: Keep current default and require opt-in
options.body: Preserve the 30-minute default and solve async review flows through explicit per-deployment `agentComponents.ttlMs` configuration.

options.title: Choose an intermediate bound
options.body: Revise the default or maximum to a shorter maintainer-approved window before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept 7 days and 30 days after docs fix
recommendation.body: Land the proposed policy once the stale gateway config reference is updated and maintainers accept the longer authorized callback window.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior TTL configuration work and have recent Discord/config history on the affected surfaces.
